newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's short-term PHIBOR eases, others steady.
newsitem.headline: Manila's short-term PHIBOR eases, others steady.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were easier at the short end of the curve, but remained unchanged in other maturities, traders said.

They said short-term swap rates declined in line with corresponding spot rates due to excess liquidity in the system. Banks have been beefing up their deposit base with an eye on end-of-year balance sheets.
Traders were still cautious on how Treasury bills would perform at Monday's weekly auction.
PHIBOR rates are are average swap quotes of 20 banks operating in the country.
